caption: The drawing features a single human figure standing within a tall, rounded archway that has yellow, red, and black accents. The figure is dressed in a long, brownish-green robe with vertical dot and line patterns, and wears a crown that is gold with red and black details. The figure's skin is pale, and they are looking slightly sideways, holding a large black cross with both hands, one near the base and one near the top. To the right of the figure is a tall pedestal colored yellow and red, upon which rests a white human skull with black outline details. The figure stands on a red, grey, and white stylized base. The background within the archway is predominantly yellow, bordered by a thick red stripe inside the arch, all set against an off-white page. The composition is symmetrical and vertically oriented, with all main objects centered within the archway.
title: Plate 12: Saint Rita: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
